reviews.text: Some of the dogs had completely no water and we tried to let the staff know but we were ignored.

The lady working there was extremely unfriendly. I noticed some cats had no water at all, so I politely pointed it out to her and even showed her the situation. Her response was to ignore me, then simply say “no English,” without addressing the issue. Really disappointing and concerning, especially when animal welfare is involved.

I had some concerns about the staff's attitude.

A toy poodle was being held after being taken out of its cage. When I approached to pet it, the staff member silently swatted their hand away, as if to say, "Stay away." A simple word would have been understandable, but their reaction was extremely unpleasant.

I question whether their staff receive proper training and instruction on customer service. It's a shame, as they have so many cute dogs, but the staff's attitude ruined everything.

Customer service directly impacts a store's image and trustworthiness. This experience was very disappointing; I was honestly shocked and upset, and left immediately. I will not be using their services again.

I recommend that future customers choose stores with good customer service.

Rude staff, the dogs are cute and all but they are very skinny and have no fold in their cage. One dog was afraid and wanting to leave its cage and has to sit in a cage with their own poo. Staff won’t even let you hold them I went to different stores but same brand same thing for all dogs and staff.  I wouldn’t come back I would recommend moffu a dog cafe very cheap and not only has teacup dogs but samoyeds and bigger dog breeds staff is nice to.

ADOPT, DON'T SHOP! This place literally sell BABY pets. Animals are not purchasable things. I am shocked that they opened up a store in the middle of the city and they sell kittens and puppies. Would give 0 star review if I could.

If I could give this pet shop zero stars, I would.
We visited because the puppies caught our attention—they are extremely cute.
However, the staff’s behavior was unacceptable. They showed no concern for the puppies, who were crying and fighting in their cages.

I politely tried to speak with one of the staff members, but she refused to listen and even pushed me. Excuse me—this is completely unacceptable.

We are tourists and came here to visit respectfully. We did not touch anything or make any noise.

Please learn to treat both animals and people with basic respect.

While the animals are undeniably cute, I was disappointed by the staff’s attention. Two puppies were play-fighting, and one clearly seemed distressed and crying, yet it didn’t appear to be addressed. Instead, the focus remained on brushing a Pomeranian that was getting a lot of attention for being “cute.” As a pet owner, it was upsetting to watch and made me concerned about how closely the animals’ well-being is monitored.
I am looking for a black teacup poodle boy or girl.

I recently made a purchase. The staff who assisted me weren't bad, but even though I received their service, there were far too many mistakes from the start, through the procedures, and even after I received the item. Also, they said I didn't need to feed the animal today, but it was surprisingly hungry. It was very greedy. I became quite worried.

I visited the store around 3 PM on August 6th.

I was assisted by a blonde, ponytail-wearing female staff member, "Kuni-san," but she spoke to me in a scolding tone from the start, and I didn't feel welcome at all.

Furthermore, while I was looking at a cat, another slightly overweight female staff member took it away without saying anything, claiming it was "grooming." I was still looking at the cat, and I was very disappointed and uncomfortable.

Overall, the staff's customer service was purely businesslike, and I didn't feel that they treated the animals with genuine care. It felt more like a place to "get things done" than a place to "find owners for pets."

It's simply horrific. I can hardly bear to see the animals there. It's torture and suffering. Please stop supporting these places! The animals are in those cages 24/7, receiving no love, no affection!
These babies are too young to be without their mother. Adopt don't shop.

Would give zero stars if I could. The store is absolutely an animal cruelty zone. The staff is so cold and careless. A puppy was about to barf and another one’s poop had blood. When we notified the staff, she simply wiped away the blood and walked away from us. The puppies are also ridiculously small and malnourished.

It is a horrible store! That is pure animal cruelty!! Those dogs and cats should still be with their mom and they sit in a tiny glass cage as an attraction instead of being able to walk around! Whoever finds that cute and supports this kind …
We don't stock much pet food.

I am torn with this review. There is an adorable puppy Chihuahua that we’ve seen that I hope someone will take. とてもかわいい！ She has such a playful, spunky personality and her disposition is good. She shows good socialization and temperament. …
